title: The category of etale neighbourhoods of a point admits common refinements and equalisers
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma establishes two properties of the category of etale neighbourhoods of a point: any two neighbourhoods admit a common refinement, and two morphisms inducing the same map on residue fields are equalised by a further etale neighbourhood. The proof constructs the common refinement by taking a suitable etale neighbourhood of the diagonal, and obtains the equaliser by passing to a neighbourhood on which the two morphisms agree, using the residue-field hypothesis to force the agreement. Constructing the equaliser from the residue-field condition is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 10172-10200.
